beats.job: Establish the subject of the piece at wide shot scale before any detail or data appears.
beats.intended_understanding: The viewer understands the piece is about one delivered work crate, shown whole.
beats.initial_state: The crate is fully masked; only the headline and the empty stage are visible.
beats.transformation: A mask sweeps across the stage and uncovers the crate in full.
beats.proof_state: The crate is uncovered in full at the midpoint of the reveal, mid-sweep.
beats.final_state: The whole crate sits uncovered and still, held as the opening statement.
essential_text: Inside every delivery: the work itself

beats.job: Move to a close shot scale and attach the one detail that matters to the subject.
beats.viewer_question: What should I notice about it?
beats.intended_understanding: The viewer understands the crate carries a counted detail, and the count is part of the object, not decoration.
beats.initial_state: The crate is shown closer, without its detail chip.
beats.transformation: The detail chip fades and scales in, attached to the crate, and settles.
beats.proof_state: The chip is fully present beside the crate, reading 128 crates delivered this week.
beats.final_state: Crate and chip hold together as one composed close shot.
essential_text: The work, with its detail attached

beats.job: Present the proof peak: the counted claim, drawn on one shared scale.
beats.intended_understanding: The viewer understands packed, shipped, and delivered counts on one shared scale, with delivered the largest and nothing rescaled.
beats.initial_state: The stage is composed with title, labels, and scale, and no bars are drawn yet.
beats.transformation: The three bars grow together on the shared scale, preserving their ratios.
beats.proof_state: All three bars stand at full truthful widths: 480, 720, and 1200 source pixels in landscape orientation.
beats.final_state: The completed chart holds unchanged as the proof state of the piece.
essential_text: The count, on one shared scale

beats.job: End on a designed final state: the summary held still, not a fade to nothing.
beats.intended_understanding: The viewer understands the piece ends deliberately: delivered, checked, and held, all at full value, held to the last frame.
beats.initial_state: The summary stage is composed with its headline and no bars drawn yet.
beats.transformation: The three summary bars rise quickly to full value together.
beats.proof_state: Delivered, checked, and held all stand at full width, the designed final state.
beats.final_state: The final state holds unchanged through the last frame of the program.
